Review direction (Jack Heart, 2026-11-12): "Cache._slice . Needing _ vars is often code smell for poor factoring". Fold the hash-skip into verification itself: replace `_verify(path, content)` with one Cache method every read path uses (`_slice`, `_load`, `held`, `place`), which hashes a file once and trusts it while a small named identity record (inode, size, mtime) is unchanged. Delete `_sliced` and the special case in `_slice`; no bare tuple[int, int, int]; state the rule once in the module note; the PR description should describe the concept, not a private method. Keep the rest of PR #93 as is.
